title.en: “Closed Compression Expansion Tanks” leaves Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³ on the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump row
title.zh: 「Closed 压缩 膨胀 罐」不改柴油120型混凝土泵这一行里的「料斗容积 0.6 m³」

description.en: Diesel 120 Concrete Pump at /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump. Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³ Outlet Pressure 40 MPa
description.zh: 柴油120型混凝土泵见 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump。料斗容积 0.6 m³整机重量 8000 kg。

h1.en: Closed Compression Expansion Tanks does not retitle the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump cells
h1.zh: 「Closed 压缩 膨胀 罐」并不改写柴油120型混凝土泵的格子

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Diesel 120 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump. Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³. Outlet Pressure 40 MPa. Main Unit Weight 8000 kg. Theoretical Output 100 m³/h. Aggregate Size 6 cm and below. The printed output cell is 100 m³/h. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112 (two units). Dimensions (L×W×H) 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. The published cells are: Model Diesel 120. Copy only the printed cells: Model Diesel 120. Engine Power (Diesel) 290 kW (two units 145 kW). The printed power cell is 290 kW (two units 145 kW). Put /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump in the subject. The printed aggregate or particle cell is 6 cm and below. The printed distance row or rows: Conveying Distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm and Main Unit Weight is 8000 kg. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump at /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump. Theoretical Output is 100 m³/h OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump. The section title “Open Expansion Tanks” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是柴油120型混凝土泵的数字。要打开的行是 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump。料斗容积 0.6 m³.整机重量 8000 kg。最大出口压力 40 MPa.理论输送量 100 m³/h.已印输送量是 100 m³/h。只抄已印格子：型号 Diesel 120.已公布的格子是：型号 Diesel 120.最大骨料粒径 6 cm and below.已印骨料或粒径是 6 cm and below。外形尺寸 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm.液压泵 Kawasaki 112 (two units).柴油机功率 290 kW (two units 145 kW).已印动力是 290 kW (two units 145 kW)。已印距离行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 500 m。主题里写上 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump。运输请抄外形尺寸是 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm，整机重量是 8000 kg。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油120型混凝土泵列在 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump。理论输送量是 100 m³/h OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump 开始。节标题「明 膨胀 罐」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: For Diesel 120 Concrete Pump, the heading “Open Expansion Tanks” does not replace a cell. Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³. Aggregate Size 6 cm and below. The published cells are: Model Diesel 120. Put /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump in the subject. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump at /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump.
body.zh: 对柴油120型混凝土泵而言，标题「明 膨胀 罐」并不替换任何格子。料斗容积 0.6 m³.最大骨料粒径 6 cm and below.河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油120型混凝土泵列在 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump。已公布的格子是：型号 Diesel 120.主题里写上 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump。

heading.zh: Closed 压缩 膨胀 罐

body.en: Diesel 120 Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Closed Compression Expansion Tanks”. Outlet Pressure 40 MPa. The printed output cell is 100 m³/h. Copy only the printed cells: Model Diesel 120. The printed aggregate or particle cell is 6 cm and below. Theoretical Output is 100 m³/h OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump.
body.zh: 柴油120型混凝土泵不因标题「Closed 压缩 膨胀 罐」而改动。最大出口压力 40 MPa.已印输送量是 100 m³/h。只抄已印格子：型号 Diesel 120.已印骨料或粒径是 6 cm and below。理论输送量是 100 m³/h OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump 开始。

body.en: This section is titled “Diaphragm Expansion Tanks”. Diesel 120 Concrete Pump still prints the cells below. Main Unit Weight 8000 kg. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112 (two units). Engine Power (Diesel) 290 kW (two units 145 kW). The printed distance row or rows: Conveying Distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m.
body.zh: 本节标题是「Diaphragm 膨胀 罐」。柴油120型混凝土泵下面这些格子仍是印出来的。整机重量 8000 kg。液压泵 Kawasaki 112 (two units).柴油机功率 290 kW (two units 145 kW).已印距离行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 500 m。

heading.en: Example - Volume in Open Expansion Tank
heading.zh: 示例 - 体积 在 明 膨胀 罐

body.en: Under “Example - Volume in Open Expansion Tank”, Diesel 120 Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. Theoretical Output 100 m³/h. Dimensions (L×W×H) 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. The printed power cell is 290 kW (two units 145 kW). For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm and Main Unit Weight is 8000 kg. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/expansion-tanks-d_885.html.
body.zh: 在「示例 - 体积 在 明 膨胀 罐」下，柴油120型混凝土泵这一节只放已印出的格子。理论输送量 100 m³/h.外形尺寸 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm.已印动力是 290 kW (two units 145 kW)。运输请抄外形尺寸是 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm，整机重量是 8000 kg。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/expansion-tanks-d_885.html。

question.en: Does “Open Expansion Tanks” replace Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³?
question.zh: 「明 膨胀 罐」会替换「料斗容积 0.6 m³」吗？

answer.en: No. Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³ remains the printed wording for Diesel 120 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。料斗容积 0.6 m³仍是柴油120型混凝土泵已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Outlet Pressure 40 MPa belong on the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 柴油120型混凝土泵这一行里，「整机重量 8000 kg。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Closed Compression Expansion Tanks” add to Diesel 120 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「Closed 压缩 膨胀 罐」给柴油120型混凝土泵增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/expansion-tanks-d_885.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/expansion-tanks-d_885.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³?
question.zh: 「料斗容积 0.6 m³」旁边印了标价吗？
